description: This file defines a report for loan interest details in a loan management system, including functions to fetch and process loan data, interest accruals, pledges, and security values.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the loan interest report, returning columns and data.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report.

methods.name: get_active_loan_details
methods.description: Fetches and processes active loan details, including calculations for outstanding amounts and security values.

methods.name: get_sanctioned_amount_map
methods.description: Retrieves sanctioned loan amounts for applicants.

methods.name: get_payments
methods.description: Fetches total payments made against each loan.

methods.name: get_interest_accruals
methods.description: Calculates interest accruals, overdue interest, and penalties for loans.

methods.name: get_penal_interest_rate_map
methods.description: Retrieves penalty interest rates for loan types.

methods.name: get_loan_wise_pledges
methods.description: Fetches current pledges and unpledges for loans.

methods.name: get_loan_wise_security_value
methods.description: Calculates security values for loans based on pledged securities.
